releaseTitle: DCEAY v2.1.0 — One App. All Your Music
changelog:
DCEAY v2.1.0 Release:
• Complete Flutter Ground-Up Rebuild & Android Media Subsystem.
• 01. Cover-to-Background Engine: Dynamic album cover blur, RGB color sampling, and ambient glow.
• 02. Syllable-by-Syllable Synced Lyrics Studio: Real-time syllable & word karaoke highlight, translation toggle, ms offset calibration, and LRC timestamp editor.
• 03. Universal Link Engine & Smart Playlist Import: Direct Spotify/YouTube oEmbed metadata analysis and offline audio file vault (.mp3/.flac/.wav/.m4a).
• 04. Authoritative Playback Engine: Single-source playback with audio_service background notifications, lock-screen controls, and headset media buttons.
• 05. Personalization Studio: Cyberpunk Neon (#ff00ff & #00ffff with double borders), Glassmorphism (#14141e99, #e6e6e6, #ffffff1a), Dark Obsidian, and AMOLED Pitch Black (#000000).
• 06. GitHub In-App Auto-Updater: Direct release checking against https://github.com/MEYYYNASH/DCEAYMUSICAD.git with SHA-256 integrity verification.
